description: This file defines an internal C# class 'AdoNetStreamQueueMapper' that maps Orleans stream and queue identifiers to ADO.NET queue identifiers. It manages caching of these mappings using ConcurrentDictionary and provides methods to retrieve specific or all ADO.NET queue IDs based on Orleans identifiers.
external_files: assuming 'mapper' is an external dependency implementing 'IConsistentRingStreamQueueMapper'

classes.name: AdoNetStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Maps Orleans streams and queues identifiers to ADO.NET queue identifiers, caching results for efficient retrieval.

methods.name: GetAdoNetQueueId (StreamId)
methods.description: Retrieves the ADO.NET QueueId for the specified Orleans StreamId, using cache or factory function.

methods.name: GetAdoNetQueueId (QueueId)
methods.description: Retrieves the ADO.NET QueueId for the specified Orleans QueueId, using cache or factory function.

methods.name: GetAllAdoNetQueueIds
methods.description: Returns all ADO.NET QueueIds currently mapped, by querying the external 'mapper' for all queues.
